rationale: Price is at 95.2% of today's range with the last five 5-minute candles showing tight, choppy consolidation near the high-of-day on sharply declining volume (70k → 12k–28k), which is consistent with distribution rather than a clean continuation setup. There is no identifiable news catalyst, no historical analogs, and the ATR of $0.07 offers insufficient room to size a trade with acceptable risk relative to the spread; a short is unattractive because the 9-EMA is holding as support right at price, and a long is unattractive because the stock is already extended ~12.7% above the prior close with momentum stalling. The evidence does not favor a directional edge in either direction.
